body:
## Summary
- Selected release version: 0.3.0, requested by issue #346 and valid under the pre-1.0 SemVer minor-release policy.
- Bumped `.agent/package.json` and `.agent/package-lock.json` from 0.2.0 to 0.3.0.
- Added `.agent/CHANGELOG.md` notes for install lifecycle, goals, provider/model policy, global pause guards, docs reorganization, and fixes since v0.2.0.

## Verification
- `node -e` package/package-lock version consistency check
- `git diff --check`
- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- `node -e` release-version parser validation for `0.3.0` / `v0.3.0`

Closes #346
title: Prepare Sepo 0.3.0 release
